ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jan-25-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: Gina Gonzales, CSR: Angie Diner.
Petitioner: Duvia P. Ocadia Cruz, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor: Romi Merary Aguilar Ocadiz, and with Spanish Interpreter: Cynthia Yannacone, were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Romi Merary Ocadiz-Cruz.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-14-2006 Reset To Jan-25-07 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha/Gina Gonzales, CSR: Sonia Wong.
Petitioner: Duvia P. Ocadia Cruz, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for Minor: Romi Merary Aguilar Ocadiz, and with Spanish Interpreter: Cynthia Yannacone.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
Lacks the Minor's Father consent and/ or proof of service or notice, the OSC for Change of Name of a Minor: Romi Merary Aguilar Ocadiz, is continued to Jan. 25, 2007 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
Petitioner to file an amended Order to Show Cause and submit proof of service to the Minor's father of the new hearing date or Order dispensing with notice.
